description: Estimate the import duties and taxes the recipient pays on one item shipped from the UK with SAMOS. Provide a product description or HS code. Heavily rate limited: only call when the user asks for a duties/tax estimate.

country_of_origin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the item was made, e.g. GB, CN.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency of the value, e.g. GBP (default), EUR, USD.

description.description: Product description, e.g. "cotton t-shirt". Required unless hs_code is given.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination code. Use list_destinations for supported countries.

hs_code.description: HS / tariff code, e.g. "6109100010". Required unless description is given.

weight_kg.description: Weight of one item in kg (optional).

name: estimate_duties
title: Estimate import duties and taxes
